callees.name: render_header
callees.pre_condition: state is a populated State instance
callees.post_condition: Returns a Rich-renderable object displaying the dashboard title and project identification derived from state

callees.name: render_stages
callees.pre_condition: state is a populated State instance whose pipeline-stage progress counters have been set
callees.post_condition: Returns a Rich-renderable object displaying per-stage pipeline progress expressed as processed-function counts against totals for each pipeline stage

callees.name: render_cache
callees.pre_condition: state is a populated State instance whose cache-hit-rate attribute contains a value between 0.0 and 1.0
callees.post_condition: Returns a Rich-renderable object displaying prompt-cache statistics, including the hit rate expressed as a percentage derived from state.cache_hit_rate

callees.name: render_bugs
callees.pre_condition: state is a populated State instance whose bug-validation summary collections have been set
callees.post_condition: Returns a Rich-renderable object displaying the current counts of confirmed, not-confirmed, and total bug-validation verdicts

callees.name: render_tokens
callees.pre_condition: state is a populated State instance whose token-usage accumulators have been set for both verification LLM calls and OpenCode subprocess calls
callees.post_condition: Returns a Rich-renderable object displaying cumulative token-usage and cost figures split into verification-related subtotals, OpenCode-subprocess subtotals, and a combined total

callees.name: render_llm_status
callees.pre_condition: state is a populated State instance whose OpenCode LLM trace counters have been set
callees.post_condition: Returns a Rich-renderable object displaying the current LLM invocation status and related metrics

callees.name: render_recent
callees.pre_condition: state is a populated State instance whose event collection contains one or more structured trace events
callees.post_condition: Returns a Rich-renderable object displaying the most recent structured trace events from state's event collection
